title: Design tokens
description: theme/tokens.json: every color, font, size, spacing, radius, shadow and layout value used by the stylesheets. Each token becomes a CSS custom property on :root: `color.navy` → `--color-navy`, `semantic.brand` → `--brand` (semantic tokens are unprefixed), every other group → `--{group}-{key}`. A value may reference another token as "{group.key}". Re-theme a parish by editing this file only; component CSS never uses raw values for these.

color.description: Raw palette. Referenced by semantic tokens; components should use semantic tokens.

semantic.description: Roles used by components (brand, accent, surface, text, border...).

font.description: Font stacks. `slavonic` is used only for Russian / Church Slavonic accents.
